title: Old Goa UNESCO Monuments Walk
subtitle: Journey through the 'Rome of the East'
description: A 2.5 km walking trail covering Old Goa's grandest 16th and 17th-century basilicas, cathedrals, and convent museums.

coverImage.caption: Basilica of Bom Jesus on Old Goa UNESCO Trail
coverImage.author: Praveen P

highlights: Walk between the unplastered Bom Jesus Basilica and Se Cathedral
Inspect the Golden Bell inside Asia's largest cathedral spire
Admire Vatican-inspired cupola architecture at St. Cajetan
Examine Goan-rendered ivory and gold sacred art at Santa Monica Convent

title: Bardez Coastal Fortresses Circuit
subtitle: Defenders of the Arabian Sea & Mandovi Estuary
description: Explore the strategic 16th and 17th-century coastal bastions guarding North Goa's maritime gateways.

coverImage.caption: Fort Aguada lighthouse overlooking Sinquerim bay
coverImage.author: Frederick Noronha

highlights: Stand inside Fort Aguada's 2.3-million-gallon freshwater cistern
Visit Mario Miranda art galleries at restored Reis Magos Fort
Trek up Chapora laterite battlements for Vagator sunset views

title: Ponda Spiritual Sanctuaries Trail
subtitle: Sacred Havens of Peace & Deccani Heritage
description: Discover Ponda's 16th to 18th-century sanctuaries where Hindu deities were safeguarded and Islamic mosques flourished.

coverImage.caption: Deepastambha tower at Shantadurga Temple in Kavlem
coverImage.author: Frederick Noronha

highlights: Reflect beside the 1560 Bijapuri ablution tank at Safa Masjid
Photograph the pink Deepastambha tower at Kavlem
Learn how Mangueshi temple's idol was moved in 1560 under cover of night

title: Panaji Heritage & Fontainhas Stroll
subtitle: Azulejo Tiles, Oyster Windows & Baroque Steps
description: An intimate walking trail through Panaji's Latin Quarter, riverfront promenades, and hill churches.

coverImage.caption: Colonial street scene in Fontainhas, Panaji
coverImage.author: Frederick Noronha

highlights: Admire hand-painted azulejo ceramic house numbers
Observe oyster-shell window panes (Carepas) in traditional villas
Climb the 1871 white double-flight stairs at Panaji Church
